## Finding studies

Candidate studies come from evidence repositories (the 3ie Development Evidence
Portal, J-PAL, Innovations for Poverty Action, NBER, the AEA RCT Registry and
OpenAlex) and from Latin American sources (the IDB, IPEA, INEGI). Search terms and
inclusion criteria: *to be written*.

## Extracting results

Each study's reported effects are drafted from the paper and then independently
re-checked against the cited page and table. Every estimate records where in the
paper it came from.

## Verification

A person verifies every estimate against the paper before it is used. Only
verified estimates enter the analyses.

## Analysis

Effects are pooled with random-effects meta-analysis in R (`metafor`). Effect-size
metric, handling of multiple estimates per study, and heterogeneity reporting: *to be
written*.
